profile.headline: Software Developer at Motili
profile.summary:
Giovany is a business-minded technologist who combines leadership, program management, and full-stack development to deliver practical, results-driven solutions. He earned his Bachelor of Science in Business Administration from Colorado State University, specializing in Organization and Innovation Management with a certificate in Marketing Communications and Branding.

After building a foundation in team leadership and operations management, Giovany transitioned into program and project roles with DECA Inc. and the International City/County Management Association, where he supported large-scale initiatives, managed events, worked with CRM systems, and collaborated across cross-functional teams.

Most recently, he earned a Full Stack Development certificate from the University of Denver and now applies his technical expertise at Motili. In his current role, he develops and maintains modern front-end applications using React and Vue. He works closely with cross-functional teams to build responsive interfaces, improve application performance, and translate business requirements into clean, maintainable code.

positions.title: Knack Advanced Developer
positions.description:
• Communicated with clients to track deadlines and verify required needs were being met
• Built on current knowledge and learned new programs to meet project requirements. Newly learned skills included Konva, Firebase, and Knack. Further developed skills included React JS, Javascript ES6+, CSS3, and HTML5
• Handled multiple deadlines and projects, making sure all requirements were meet on a timely basis. Continually adjusted responsibilities to reach client needs

positions.title: Assistant Program Manager II
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description:
•	Resolved membership issues over the phone and email, processed membership applications, and created weekly membership reports using NetForum and Excel while explaining data collection processes to upper management. 
•	Analyzed and processed quarterly financial expense reports and submitted to finance department for approval. 
•	Supported a “Call for Volunteers” outreach project by editing website language, creating reports of current committee members and new applicants, and assisted with social media posts. 
•	Scheduled and operated monthly virtual calls and updated rosters for the MIT and Senior Advisor programs. 
•	Created weekly content for the Leadership Matters Newsletter and updated work processes to be more remote friendly.

positions.title: Program Assistant
positions.description:
•	Responded directly to requests for information and materials with exceptional customer service
•	Prepared materials for and assisted in the operations of an educational conference of over 20,000 attendees
•	Used Microsoft Office, Adobe Acrobat, and database programs to perform daily work tasks
•	Performed general administrative tasks

positions.title: PT Flex Preload Supervisor
positions.description:
•	Oversaw operations and directed six to ten Package Handlers, ensuring accepted levels of productivity and accuracy were met to stay on schedule and meet shipment deadlines
•	Cultivated functional working relationships with all personnel throughout the organization via interpersonal skills
•	Developed solutions to daily preload issues with management in a fast-paced work environment

positions.title: Flow Team Member
positions.description:
•	Attended to the needs of guests with an effective manor, resolving all questions and issues
•	Unloaded shipments and stocked inventory while collaborating with team members to achieve daily work goals

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
•	Collaborated within a small team to acquire seven new clientele through dynamic pitch presentations
•	Attended client acquisition business meetings between Ascend and potential clients
•	Assisted client acquisition by editing outreach emails and gathered contact information of twenty potential leads into an Excel database

positions.title: Carhop
positions.description:
•	Assisted new team members with learning daily job tasks within two weeks
•	Provided customer service while performing sanitary tasks, preparing food, and managing customer payments

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration

honors.title: BBB Torch Awards Project
honors.description:
•	Lead a team of four in evaluating Hall-Irwin Corporation over their ethical characteristics based on guidelines set by the BBB Torch Awards Project
•	Held a meeting with a Hall-Irwin employee to conduct research about Hall-Irwin’s ethical actions and guidelines
honors.issuer: Issued by Better Business Bureau Institute for Marketplace Trust · Feb 2017

projects.title: Haggle
projects.description: This application allows users to trade goods and services for other goods and services on a cashless/currency-less platform. You are able to view listings from all other users and send an email of interest to the poster to start the hagglin' process.

projects.title: MVC Tech Blog
projects.description: A simple tech blog that allows users to post about current tech and leave comments on others posts.
